Companies I've helped grow

Sound familiar?

Problems I Like Solving

Six failure modes I see over and over in B2B GTM. Each one maps directly to a solution below. Same number, same fix.

01

Invisible in Search & AI Answers

Your buyers are searching Google and asking ChatGPT, and they're finding your competitors. Paid spend leaks, organic is flat, and AI engines don't know you exist.

02

Miscalibrated Channel Mix

You're spread across a dozen channels with no idea which ones actually produce pipeline. Spend follows habit, not signal.

03

Customer Interest Dies in Slide Decks

Prospects tell you exactly what they want, but the ideas stall somewhere between the sales call and the roadmap. Nothing ships.

04

Disconnected Systems, Gut-Feel Decisions

Your data lives in ten tools that don't talk to each other. Decisions get made on anecdotes and whoever argues loudest.

05

Strategy Without an Operating Cadence

The annual plan gets written, then ignored. Priorities drift, teams run their own plays, and nobody is accountable to the goals.

06

Generic Messaging, Blurry Positioning

You sound like every other vendor. One message for every segment, persona, and stage, so it lands with no one.

What I bring

Solutions I Provide

Mirrored one-to-one with the problems above. Strategy plus hands-on execution, not a deck and a handshake.

01

Digital Marketing Management

Hands-on PPC, SEO, and AEO programs that put you in front of buyers wherever they look: search engines and AI answers alike.

Fixes: Invisible in Search & AI Answers

02

Channel Mix Calibration

Rebalance paid search, social, events (regional, conferences, digital), partners, outbound, inbound, podcasts, print, and web, weighted by what actually converts.

Fixes: Miscalibrated Channel Mix

03

Product Prototyping

Turn customer interest into working prototypes and product deliverables: fast, testable, and ready to put in front of buyers.

Fixes: Customer Interest Dies in Slide Decks

04

Systems Integration & Data Visualization

Connect internal systems and visualize the data that matters, so decisions get made on evidence, not opinion.

Fixes: Disconnected Systems, Gut-Feel Decisions

05

Operational Strategy & OKRs

A seasoned OKR operator's playbook: clear objectives, measurable results, and a cadence that keeps every team pulling in the same direction.

Fixes: Strategy Without an Operating Cadence

06

Segmentation, Positioning & Brand Creative

GTM segmentation, persona-level messaging, sharp positioning, and brand creative that make buyers instantly get why you're different.

Fixes: Generic Messaging, Blurry Positioning

The approach

How I Work

01

Understand

Audit your current GTM motion: market, customers, channels, team structure, and competitive landscape. Identify what's working, what's broken, and what's missing entirely.

02

Prioritize

Not everything needs fixing at once. Rank opportunities by impact, effort, and speed-to-pipeline. Pick the high-leverage moves that unlock the most value fastest.

03

Execute

Build and ship: messaging, campaigns, tools, processes. No 90-day strategy decks. Real work that hits the market and starts generating signal immediately.

04

Optimize

Measure what matters. Double down on what converts. Kill what doesn't. Continuously tighten the loop between spend, pipeline, and revenue.
